issues.title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript + Three.js project
issues.body:
## Goal
A project that installs, runs, tests and builds with one command each.

## Done when
- [x] `npm run dev`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all work
- [x] Strict TypeScript
- [x] README, licence, editor config

issues.title: Port the engine prototype into modules with a tested model
issues.body:
## Goal
Split the single-file prototype into a pure engine model, a scene, a synth and UI code, so the drawing and the sound read from the same numbers.

## Done when
- [x] `src/engine/model.ts` has no DOM or Three.js imports
- [x] Unit tests cover firing order, pulse gaps, piston geometry and revs
- [x] All five sheets render on desktop and phone widths

issues.title: Run tests and build on every push
issues.body:
## Goal
GitHub Actions runs `npm test` and `npm run build` on pushes to main and on pull requests.

## Done when
- [x] `.github/workflows/ci.yml` exists and passes

issues.title: Tune the exhaust sound by ear
issues.body:
## Goal
The synth has never been listened to by a person. Make idle sound like a lumpy boxer burble and high revs sound like an engine, not a buzz.

## Done when
- [ ] Idle with unequal headers has a clear uneven beat
- [ ] Equal headers sound noticeably smoother at the same revs
- [ ] No clicks when starting, stopping or switching headers
- [ ] Volume is comfortable on laptop speakers and headphones

## Notes
Knobs are in `src/audio/exhaust.ts`: thump frequencies (74 / 108 / 96 Hz), decay time, noise amount, low-pass cutoff. Compare against a real recording by ear; do not ship a recording.

issues.title: Move the synth from ScriptProcessorNode to an AudioWorklet
issues.body:
## Goal
`ScriptProcessorNode` is deprecated and runs on the main thread, so a slow frame can make the sound stutter.

## Done when
- [ ] Synthesis runs in an `AudioWorkletProcessor`
- [ ] rpm, throttle and header mode reach it through `AudioParam`s or messages
- [ ] Falls back cleanly where worklets are unavailable
- [ ] No console deprecation warning

issues.title: Verify which bank has the longer exhaust run, and the equal-length claim
issues.body:
## Goal
Two things on the page are not sourced yet.

1. The drawing gives cylinders 2 and 4 (car's left) the longer pipe run. Confirm which side it really is on the EJ207 / EJ257, and fix the model if needed.
2. An earlier draft claimed Japanese-market STIs of this era used equal-length headers with a twin-scroll turbo. Confirm with a reliable source before it goes on the page.

## Done when
- [ ] Both points recorded in `docs/FACTS.md` with links
- [ ] `PULSE_DELAY` and the pipe routing match the finding, or stay labelled as illustrative

issues.title: Phone layout: the notes cover the engine on the rumble sheet
issues.body:
## Goal
At 400px wide the sheet 4 panel is tall enough to hide most of the drawing.

## Done when
- [ ] At least the top 35% of the screen shows the engine on every sheet at 360 to 430px wide
- [ ] Options: shorter copy on phones, a collapsible note, or a smaller timeline

issues.title: Smooth scrolling and a snap point per sheet
issues.body:
## Goal
Scrolling should glide between sheets like the reference sites (lusion.co, unseen.co).

## Done when
- [ ] Lenis (or equivalent) drives scroll with inertia
- [ ] Each sheet is a gentle snap point
- [ ] Disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] Keyboard (space, arrows, page up/down) still moves one sheet at a time

issues.title: Intro screen with a sound choice
issues.body:
## Goal
Open on a title card with two buttons: enter with sound, enter without. The click also satisfies the browser's rule that audio needs a user gesture.

## Done when
- [ ] Intro shows while the scene prepares, then fades into sheet 1
- [ ] Choosing sound starts the engine at idle
- [ ] Choice can be changed later from the dock

issues.title: Accessibility pass on the engine chapter
issues.body:
## Done when
- [ ] Every control reachable and operable by keyboard, with a visible focus ring
- [ ] The canvas has a text alternative describing what each sheet shows
- [ ] Live readouts do not spam screen readers
- [ ] Colour contrast passes WCAG AA in both themes
- [ ] Tested with reduced motion on

issues.title: Performance: measure on a mid-range Android phone
issues.body:
## Goal
Only tested in a desktop headless browser so far.

## Done when
- [ ] Frame rate recorded on a real mid-range Android phone on mobile data
- [ ] Rendering pauses when the tab is hidden
- [ ] Pixel ratio and geometry detail scale down on slow devices
- [ ] JS bundle size recorded; Three.js imports trimmed if worthwhile

issues.title: Add the turbo, intercooler, intake and timing belt to the drawing
issues.body:
## Goal
The engine is bare: block, heads, crank, pistons, headers. Add the parts people recognise, in the same blueprint style, with labels.

## Done when
- [ ] Turbocharger, top-mount intercooler, intake manifold and timing belt cover drawn
- [ ] Each has a label that appears on the relevant sheet
- [ ] Part names checked against a source

issues.title: Self-host the fonts
issues.body:
## Goal
Fonts load from Google Fonts. Self-hosting removes a third-party request and a flash of fallback type.

## Done when
- [ ] Barlow, Barlow Condensed and IBM Plex Mono served from the site (for example via `@fontsource`)
- [ ] Only the weights in use are shipped

issues.title: Decide how to get a Blobeye body: licensed model or built in code
issues.body:
## Goal
The biggest dependency in the project. Pick one and write down why.

- **Licensed model:** find a GD-chassis 3D model whose licence allows this use; check polygon count and whether the bonnet opens.
- **Stylised, built in code or Blender:** a low-poly or line-drawing body that matches the blueprint look and loads fast.

## Done when
- [ ] Decision recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md` with the licence terms if a model is used
- [ ] A test model loads in the scene

issues.title: Asset pipeline for 3D models
issues.body:
## Done when
- [ ] Models stored as compressed `.glb` (Draco or Meshopt)

- [ ] Size budget agreed and checked in CI or documented

issues.title: Hero stop: the car on the drawing sheet
issues.body:
## Goal
Open the site on the whole car in WR Blue line work with gold wheels, slowly turning, before any engine detail.

issues.title: X-ray stop: symmetrical all-wheel drive
issues.body:
## Goal
The body fades to an outline and the drivetrain lights up: engine, gearbox, centre differential, prop shaft, front and rear differentials.

## Done when
- [ ] Drivetrain parts drawn and labelled
- [ ] Short note explaining why the layout is called symmetrical
- [ ] Differential types checked against a source for this model year

issues.body:

issues.title: Research the rally timeline and source every claim
issues.body:
## Goal
A list of dated facts for the heritage stop, each with a link. Fan posters get these wrong, so nothing goes on the page from memory.

## To confirm
- Manufacturers' titles and years
- Drivers' titles and years (McRae, Burns, Solberg)
- Safari Rally wins: years, drivers, which car
- Which body shape competed in which seasons

## Done when
- [ ] All recorded in `docs/FACTS.md` with sources
